metadata.question: Does the area around (43.244129, -79.198692) apprear greener than (43.263113, -79.069485) in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Two points in Lake Ontario: (43.244129, -79.198692) and (43.263113, -79.069485) - Date: February 4, 2021 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for vegetation). Fallback to Landsat 8 if needed. 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking since we want to compare actual greenness (NDVI) - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - Calculate NDVI for both locations - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 (water typically -0.5 to 0, vegetation 0.2 to 0.8) - Compare: If location1 NDVI > location2 NDVI → Answer A (Yes), otherwise B (No) - Watch for: C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (invalid NDVI values) 4. Note: Both points are in Lake Ontario (water), so NDVI values will likely be low/negative. The question asks if one area "appears greener" - this is comparing relative vegetation. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries and time period const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.198692, 43.244129]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.069485, 43.263113]); const date = '2021-02-04'; const dateStart = ee.Date(date).advance(-3, 'day'); const dateEnd = ee.Date(date).advance(3, 'day'); // 2. Load Sentinel-2 collection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); let collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if no Sentinel-2 if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for either location in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Process based on collection type let ndviImage; if (collection.first().bandNames().contains('B8').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2 processing const maskClouds = function(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); }; const addNDVI = function(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); }; ndviImage = collection.map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); } else { // Landsat 8 processing const maskClouds = function(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); }; const addNDVI = function(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); }; ndviImage = collection.map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); } // 4. Calculate NDVI and pixel counts for both locations const buffer = 500; // 500m buffer around each point const region1 = point1.buffer(buffer); const region2 = point2.buffer(buffer); const stats1 = await ndviImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: region1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await ndviImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: region2, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi1 = stats1.NDVI_mean; const count1 = stats1.NDVI_count; const ndvi2 = stats2.NDVI_mean; const count2 = stats2.NDVI_count; console.log(`Point 1 (-79.198692, 43.244129): NDVI=${ndvi1 !== null ? ndvi1.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Point 2 (-79.069485, 43.263113): NDVI=${ndvi2 !== null ? ndvi2.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation and final answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2) || ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndvi1 > ndvi2) { console.log('Point 1 is greener than Point 2.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Point 1 is not greener than Point 2.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
